The '''N2 ion engine''' was a model of [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]]. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Minstrel-class space yacht/Legends|''Minstel''-class space yacht]] [[Star Jewel/Legends|''Star Jewel'']] was powered by two N2 ion engines supplemented by three [[T-c40 ion engine]]s.<ref name="EGVV" />
